sources.evidence: Ohorongo Cement's current official site identifies its Sargberg Plant north of Otavi and states that Ohorongo commenced production in December 2010 with current annual cement production capacity exceeding one million tonnes.
Ohorongo's current quality page identifies Ohorongo Cement (Pty) Ltd and Sargberg Plant Farm 585 Otavi, Namibia, and lists five cement products certified for manufacture at the operation.
Ohorongo's May 2025 CEM I 42.5R datasheet states that the product is produced at Ohorongo Cement's manufacturing facility from selected raw ingredients.
CIMERWA's 2024-2025 annual report identifies the Bugarama Plant as an operating 600,000-tonne-per-year plant and CIMERWA as Rwanda's integrated cement manufacturer.

CIMERWA's current official homepage states that it is Rwanda's integrated cement producer with 600,000 tonnes annual production capacity and lists current SURECEM, SUREBUILD, RUTARE, RAMBA and bulk solution products.
Hima Cement's current contact page identifies the KASESE PLANT in Hima Town, Kasese, Uganda as a current company operation.
Hima Cement's current SUPASET 32.5R product page explicitly states that SUPASET is manufactured out of the Hima Cement factory in Kasese, Uganda.
Hima Cement's August 2025 official news identifies Hima Cement Limited (Kasese) as a cement-processing manufacturing operation recognized by Uganda's NEMA.

name: PPC Zimbabwe Colleen Bawn integrated plant

sources.evidence: PPC's current 2026 results identify the Colleen Bawn integrated plant in Zimbabwe and report active own-clinker production and maintenance investment at the plant during FY2026.
PPC's current product page specifies Portland-composite CEM II/C-M (L-S) 32.5 N cement for Harare and Bulawayo, confirming current Zimbabwe cement manufacturing products.
